cards.title: Yantian: Shenzhen's Gem of History, Nature & Slow Living
cards.description: Discover Yantian, Shenzhen’s tranquil coastal district steeped in Neolithic history, Lingnan Hakka culture, and serene beaches. Escape the city’s hustle with Liye Jiang to explore misty mountains, migratory bird havens, and a life where time slows by the sea.

cards.title: Dutch Flowers Market
cards.description: Why was the flower market named after the Dutch? Xiaozhou Yang visited the biggest flower market in Shenzhen and told us this story.
cards.alt: 002 杨小舟（荷兰花卉小镇）

cards.title: Tsutaya Bookstore in Shenzhen
cards.description: Shangxuan loves books and is obsessed with his college life by exploring every bookstore in Shenzhen. He was fascinated by the largest Tsutaya Bookstore in southern China. This video remarks on his thoughts about books and the philosophy of life.
cards.alt: 010 李尚轩（茑屋书店）

cards.title: Fairy Tale Lake Park for a weekend (Xianhu Botanic Garden)
cards.description: Qinru pays a visit with her besties in Luohu. They discovered a secret garden and the largest botanic garden in this region.
cards.alt: 003 罗沁儒（仙湖植物园）

cards.title: Phnoenix Old Town in Shenzhen
cards.description: Where is the beginning of the history in Shenzhen? Chenxi Yuan tries to dig out the answer and finds this old town from the Song Dynasty. It reveals an undercovered history of Wen Tianxiang, a patriotic general against Jurchen invaders, and his offspring in Shenzhen.
cards.alt: 004 袁陈希（凤凰古城）

cards.title: Ancestrial Hall of Hakka Clan in Longgang (Hehu New Residence)
cards.description: The Hehu New Residence Hall is the largest Hakka ancestral hall in China which is located in Longgang district in Shenzhen. Wenjun Zhong paid a visit to this mysterious heritage site and trying to find the trace of the early generation in Shenzhen in the 18th century.
cards.alt: 007 钟文珺（鹤湖新居）

cards.title: A day at Sea World Culture and Arts Center in Shenzhen
cards.description: Jiamin arrives in Shenzhen from a little town in Yunnan. Her first experience with the sea started with the SWCAC in Shekou. This video records her excitement from this unknown journey.
cards.alt: 011 李嘉敏（海上艺术世界）

cards.title: My visit to the Hongfa Temple
cards.description: Hongfa Temple is the first Buddhist temple in Shenzhen and the newest temple in China. By paying a visit to the Hongfa Temple, Yanling Wu remembers a story of her childhood with her family on family and faith.
cards.alt: 012 吴炎玲（弘法寺）

cards.title: Bird Watching in Shenzhen
cards.description: Shenzhen is a great place for bird-watching. Apart from 421 types of birds that have been identified, there is a growing population in Shenzhen who voluntarily watch and record the behaviours of local bird species. Jiahong Sui, the Head of the Bird-watching association of Shenzhen University, has brought up her stories of bird-watching in Shenzhen.
cards.alt: 027 隋佳宏（观鸟）

cards.title: How to buy jewellery in Shuibei, Shenzhen
cards.description: Where is the largest jewellery market in Asia? Xiaoqing Yan tries to find a crafted gift and surprisingly finds Shuibei as the destination. Let us explore the evolution of Shuibei with her video.
cards.alt: 颜晓晴（水贝）
